frames.whatIsInIt: four captions. «Косой», «Ловчий» and «Сиплый» stand in a column in an empty corridor, one band apart, with no body under any of them; «Секира · волна 2 · достали (23,7)» is the only one still over its own head. This is the frame the owner described: «имена рейдеров появились только в последней волне… никого особо не запомнить».

one returning raider, «Крюк Немой · волна 1 · едва не добили (24,7)». One caption cannot collide with itself, which is why wave 3 shows the second half of the defect rather than the first: the caption is still 26 reference pixels above the render centre and its second line runs across the heads of the bodies beside it.

measuredNotGuessed.theColumnIsBuiltIn: Main.DrawWorld.cs:243-247 places every caption at ReturningHeroLabel.TopRefOf(caption.Slot) and TopRefOf has no ceiling: slot n sits n * SlotHeightRef = n * 20 reference pixels above the head.
measuredNotGuessed.whyEveryoneCollides: ReturningHeroLabel.CollisionSpanTiles = ceil(LabelWidthRef / ReferenceTileSize) = ceil(130 / 22) = 6, so any two captioned raiders within six tiles of one another and one row apart are declared to collide — whether or not the drawn glyphs touch. That is why four bunched raiders produced four different bands.
measuredNotGuessed.theOwnCreatureLabelIsNotOverTheHead: Main.Session.cs:522-525 puts the Label node's top-left at CreatureRenderCenter + (ScaleWorld(2) - tile/2, -ScaleWorld(14) - tile/2). At the shipped 40 px tile that is (-9, -25) reference pixels, and the node is ScaleWorld(98, 17) — 98 by 17 reference pixels, left-aligned. So the box runs from -9 to +89 reference pixels horizontally, four tiles to the right of the body it names, and from -25 to -8 vertically, the lower half of which is over the body's own head: the opaque pixels of the pack reach -20.6.

howTheHeadHeightWasObtained: CameraView.GoblinDrawRect(centre, tileSize).Y = centre.Y + GoblinFootLine - GoblinDrawSize * SpriteSupportFraction; at reference scale that is 20*(92/96-0.5) - 20*1.70*(188/192) = 9.1667 - 33.2917 = -24.125, and the first opaque row adds 20*1.70*(20/192) = 3.542, giving -20.583 reference pixels.
